description: This file defines the SelectedFilterField entity class used in the OrangeHRM system, representing a database table ohrm_selected_filter_field with fields related to filter configurations for reports. It includes property mappings, getters, and setters, and applies Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping.

classes.name: SelectedFilterField
classes.description: Entity class representing a selected filter field in a report, with associations to Report and FilterField entities, and properties for filter configurations and ordering.
